Place the earpiece on your left tragus (front part of the ear).
Turn it on and slowly increase intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling.
Use it for 30–60 minutes daily, ideally in the morning or split between morning and evening.
You can read, work, meditate, or relax while using it.
If the sensation fades or intensifies, adjust the level back to a comfortable tingling.
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually build up so it always feels comfortable.
